_doc: Every place PalCraft attaches to a game. One row = one hook. sys refers to systems.json. slot = vtable slot ('-' for non-vtable hooks).
rows: runs the bridge once per game frame on the game thread
draws the Minecraft layers into the finished frame, publishes state
same, for the other present call
drops back buffer views before a resize
remembers the depth buffer in use
marks depth buffers that started fresh this frame
counts draws per depth buffer; the busiest full-screen one is the scene
sees the first draw into the back buffer: the finished scene, before the interface
sees the frame tag and the view rectangle of the scene
turns Palworld's pointer changes into 'no pointer' while Minecraft holds the mouse
hears of each build-mode screen Palworld makes; it makes the first when the player first builds
hears of each character preview Palworld makes for its inventory screen
